name: Los Ingobernables: Plata o Plomo
whyWereHere:
Los Ingobernables: Plata o Plomo is built on power, pride, and the refusal to be controlled by anyone outside their circle. With RUSH and Andrade holding down the tag division and Bandido standing as the singles weapon of the group, the faction gives OWL three different problems with the same dangerous answer.

RUSH is the violence. Andrade is the strategy. Bandido is the spectacle — the masked ace who can outfly, outfight, and outshine anyone placed in front of him. Together, they bring lucha royalty, world-traveled credibility, and a code that does not bend for management, fans, or rivals.

They are not here to join OWL’s culture. They are here to change the power structure. Plata o Plomo is not just a name. It is the choice they give every opponent before the bell rings.

name: The Deddley Sistaz
whyWereHere:
From the proudly chaotic streets of Deddleyville, USA, The Deddley Sistaz arrive carrying a family tradition of violence, loyalty, and furniture-based problem solving.

Martha May is the powerhouse and loudmouth leader, capable of turning any disagreement into structural damage. Chevonne is the sharper, quicker half of the tag team, giving the family’s destruction rhythm and direction. Little Sami is the undersized singles daredevil, throwing herself into danger with the confidence of someone who knows her family will finish whatever she starts.

They argue, interrupt each other, and occasionally look one bad decision away from fighting among themselves—but nobody outside the family gets to touch one of them without answering to all three. The Deddley Sistaz are messy, loud, fiercely loyal, and always ready to get the tables.

name: Her-t Business: The Family
whyWereHere:
The Porter family has officially opened a new division in OWL.

Led by MVP, The Her-t Business represents legacy, luxury, and calculated violence. Tiffany Omari Porter is T.O.P., the composed strategist who treats the ring like a corporate battlefield. Victoria Imani Porter is V.I.P., the charismatic disruptor who wants every victory to look expensive and every opponent to look beneath her. Together, they are the future of the family brand.

MVP does not stand beside them as a sentimental father figure. He stands there as management. He taught them that presentation matters, leverage matters, and pain is just another form of currency. The Her-t Business is not here to inspire the women’s tag division.

They are here to acquire it.

name: The Blackpool Catch Club
whyWereHere: The Blackpool Catch Club exists to preserve wrestling as a serious craft while reshaping it for a more ruthless generation. William Regal provides the knowledge, strategy and uncompromising standards. Claudio Castagnoli represents the completed philosophy: a wrestler whose strength, conditioning and technique have been refined into an almost perfect competitive weapon. Charlie Dempsey represents what comes next, carrying the traditions of British catch wrestling while fighting to establish an identity beyond his lineage. Together, they operate less like a conventional faction and more like an academy with no room for weak students. Every opponent is studied, every mistake is punished and every victory becomes evidence supporting their methods. They did not come to OWL seeking popularity or chaos. They came to control Revolt through preparation, precision and the quiet certainty that wrestling mastery will always expose imitation.

name: Perros Del Mal
whyWereHere: Perros del Mal is a pack for wrestlers who refuse to be respectable for anyone else’s comfort. Mike Santana provides its scars, discipline and direction. Raquel Rodriguez supplies overwhelming force and the certainty that the group cannot be intimidated. Dominik Mysterio turns resentment into strategy, while Sammy Guevara transforms arrogance and risk into sudden violence. They are connected not by identical backgrounds, but by a shared refusal to remain trapped inside expectations created by families, partners, critics or tradition. Santana and Raquel pursue singles dominance while Dominik and Sammy hunt the Twin Talon Championship, allowing the faction to threaten every level of Revolt at once. Perros del Mal did not come to OWL to represent an idealised legacy. They came to corrupt it, weaponise it and prove that loyalty becomes far more dangerous when it belongs to people with nothing to apologise for.

name: The Powerhouse Girlz
whyWereHere: The Powerhouse Girlz were raised in Townsville as three sisters expected to become exceptional. Bloom Bella developed into the calculating leader, Bonnie Blu became the emotional centre, and Bianca Brown grew into the family’s most aggressive protector. Their personalities may differ, but each was taught that the sisters are strongest when no outsider is allowed to come between them. Bloom and Bonnie pursue tag-team dominance through strategy, speed and instinct, while Bianca targets singles championships with direct, unapologetic force. Together, they can influence every level of Revolt’s women’s division while protecting one another from consequences. They do not see themselves as bullies or villains. In their minds, they are simply using their abilities as they were always meant to be used. The Powerhouse Girlz came to OWL to conquer the competition, defend the family name and transform Townsville’s greatest creations into Revolt’s most powerful dynasty.

name: The Matriarchy
whyWereHere:
The Matriarchy is not a collection of allies. It is a family structure built around power, heritage, and unquestioned loyalty. At its head stands Tima Maolosi, the Tribal Queen who believes a dynasty can survive only when one voice gives direction. Nia Jax serves as the family’s overwhelming force, while KayLani and Leilani Osu protect its future through the synchronized violence of The Osus.

They celebrate their Samoan roots without asking OWL for permission or approval. To them, family is both sanctuary and law: those inside the circle are protected, while anyone who threatens it becomes an enemy of them all. Their unity is genuine, but Tima’s control carries a price. The Matriarchy came to Revolt to take championships, command respect, and establish a women-led dynasty no division can break.

name: Pu$$y World Order
whyWereHere:
P.W.O. turns its provocative name into a declaration of ownership. It is not sexual and it is not played for cheap shock. Shayna Baszler, Marina Shafir, and Jordynne Grace use it as a confrontational statement that women’s wrestling belongs to women who are powerful enough to define it for themselves.

Each member represents a different form of dominance. Shayna is submission-based cruelty. Marina is calculated violence. Jordynne is overwhelming physical force. Baszler and Shafir pursue tag-team control while Grace hunts singles championships, allowing P.W.O. to attack multiple parts of OWL at once.

They are not united by matching personalities or blind loyalty to a leader. They are united by the belief that women should never have to minimize their strength, aggression, bodies, or ambition to make anyone else comfortable.
